completionRule: All 50 applicable items require current source and behavior evidence; ETL-039/040 are NotApplicable. Missing environments are Blocked.

items.name: Complete product dependency closure
items.trigger: A complete product build is requested with a missing dependency.
items.baselineFinding: Drivers, HTTP and Arrow file support currently default OFF; full product profile is absent.
items.acceptance: A complete product build is requested with a missing dependency. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: An explicit PRODUCT native profile requires all native database drivers, Microsoft BCP SDK, Arrow file codecs, HTTP, CLI/Worker and JNI. Missing dependencies cannot silently become a full native product. Complete Web/extra-protocol dependency closure remains pending.

items.name: SQL parameter arrays and truthful bulk capabilities
items.trigger: A bulk destination binds a driver or requests a native loading guarantee.
items.baselineFinding: ODBC is the sole SQL Server path; array batching and native BCP must be distinguished.
items.acceptance: A bulk destination binds a driver or requests a native loading guarantee. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: ODBC parameter-array writes now use row-offset bindings and processed/status checks; PARAMETER_ARRAY and NATIVE_BULK are distinct capabilities. Microsoft BCP staged loading is implemented but not compiled or accepted.

items.name: Native execution identity
items.trigger: A new execution omits its ID or resume omits the original ID.
items.baselineFinding: runtime.c copies an empty options.execution_id; CLI substitutes constant cli; no identity getter exists.
items.acceptance: A new execution omits its ID or resume omits the original ID. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Unified current contract implementation exists; concentrated ABI 10 compile/behavior validation has not run.

items.name: Source record error ports
items.trigger: A recoverable CSV/NDJSON/SQL record contains invalid field content.
items.baselineFinding: Data cursors return field parse errors and SQL source has no unified per-record error channel.
items.acceptance: A recoverable CSV/NDJSON/SQL record contains invalid field content. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: CSV, NDJSON and SQL share the Native error schema, source row/field identity and snapshot port path. SQL drivers notify complete result records, isolate conversion/nullability failures and bound batches by fetched records; execution failures remain fatal. Explicit raw SQL retention uses the complete nullable result-cell Wire image, rejecting unavailable original values. Mixed-record and crash acceptance remain NotRun.

items.name: Expression transform row errors
items.trigger: A Derived Column or Conditional Split expression fails for one record.
items.baselineFinding: Expression row evaluation can fail an activation; recoverable row attribution must share Data error metadata.
items.acceptance: A Derived Column or Conditional Split expression fails for one record. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Cast, Derived Column and Conditional Split use one native status classification and error record writer. Execution failures cannot be ignored or redirected. Additional expression failure attribution and complete product acceptance remain pending.

items.name: Destination isolation and error barrier
items.trigger: Normal and rejected rows share a batch or a SQL statement fails for a record.
items.baselineFinding: Destination ordinary failures stop flow; both error and regular target confirmation must remain one barrier.
items.acceptance: Normal and rejected rows share a batch or a SQL statement fails for a record. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: SQL destination shares ud_record_error and an optional error port. Under declared participants, an optimistic batch is isolated with Native savepoints, then failed records use parameter binding. Execution faults cannot redirect; provider codes are sanitized. Real dual-target recovery remains pending.

items.name: Complete unsigned integer domain
items.trigger: A UINT64 value exceeds INT64_MAX.
items.baselineFinding: ud_type has no UINT64 and all integral scalar storage uses signed int64.
items.acceptance: A UINT64 value exceeds INT64_MAX. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: UINT64 storage, exact parsing/casts, comparison/hash, arithmetic, aggregation, Wire, Arrow, schema discovery and .NET/Java type projections are implemented. Provider-specific interval/type closure, domain expression coverage and behavioral acceptance remain pending.

items.name: Duration and calendar Interval
items.trigger: A negative/long SQL TIME or month/day/microsecond interval is read.
items.baselineFinding: TIME64 is microseconds since midnight; negative/long duration and calendar interval have no domain.
items.acceptance: A negative/long SQL TIME or month/day/microsecond interval is read. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Signed microsecond Duration and month/day/microsecond Interval share native parsing, storage, arithmetic, aggregation, Wire/Arrow and language projections; MySQL negative/long TIME decodes as Duration. Complete provider mapping and acceptance remain pending.

items.name: JSON and dictionary fidelity
items.trigger: MySQL JSON contains unsigned boundary values or ENUM/SET dictionary metadata.
items.baselineFinding: No schema dictionary annotation exists in ud_field.
items.acceptance: MySQL JSON contains unsigned boundary values or ENUM/SET dictionary metadata. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: CDC TRUNCATE semantics
items.trigger: A source transaction truncates a captured table.
items.baselineFinding: ud_cdc_event has no TRUNCATE event.
items.acceptance: A source transaction truncates a captured table. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: CDC TRUNCATE now uses the Native ChangeSet/receipt/Journal/epoch path for PG and MySQL-family streams. SQL reset is explicitly enabled and authorized, compiled as transactional DELETE without identity/sequence resets. Failure is not a rejected record. Real log/target acceptance remains pending.

items.name: Recoverable transaction participants
items.trigger: A required transaction includes multiple connections.
items.baselineFinding: ud_transaction owns a single lease; required transaction rejects another connection.
items.acceptance: A required transaction includes multiple connections. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Connection Manager admits all participants before effects; Journal persists prepare decisions and publishes tentative facts only after resolution. PostgreSQL PREPARE TRANSACTION, MySQL/MariaDB XA and OCI XID/DBMS_XA have implementation. Capability-qualified SQL Server participants and real crash acceptance remain pending.

items.name: Durable coordinator decisions
items.trigger: The process stops before/after prepare, decision or participant commit.
items.baselineFinding: Required transactions reject a state directory; no durable prepare/decision/recover protocol exists.
items.acceptance: The process stops before/after prepare, decision or participant commit. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Manager and Journal stage Task/Batch/Cursor/Epoch facts under a durable coordinator decision. Explicit Task/Epoch scopes publish only after branch resolution; Epoch scope rotates Native branches before source confirmation. Real crash recovery, metrics restoration and all boundary acceptance remain pending.

items.name: PostgreSQL COPY loading
items.trigger: A high-volume PostgreSQL destination is bound.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A high-volume PostgreSQL destination is bound. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Remote PostgreSQL COPY and controlled MySQL/MariaDB LOCAL INFILE share write/receipt semantics. Microsoft ODBC BCP and OCI Direct Path now stage first and apply business rows under the original transaction; remote performance and complete data-type/provider acceptance remain pending.

items.name: MySQL and MariaDB native loading
items.trigger: A native bulk destination receives controlled input bytes.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A native bulk destination receives controlled input bytes. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Genuine MySQL/MariaDB LOCAL INFILE callbacks accept only a controlled native Batch token, never a server filename. Session capability reflects local_infile availability; warnings/row-count mismatches fail and roll back with the receipt. Native append implemented; staging and real acceptance remain pending.

items.name: SQL Server BCP loading
items.trigger: A SQL Server driver declares the native BCP loading capability.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A SQL Server driver declares the native BCP loading capability. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Microsoft ODBC BCP uses its actual vendor SDK, bounded typed cells and controlled staging. Business apply and receipt remain on the original transaction; parameter-array capability is separate. Remote BCP integration/performance and Windows acceptance remain pending.

items.name: OCI staged Direct Path loading
items.trigger: Direct Path independently commits staging before transactional business writes.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: Direct Path independently commits staging before transactional business writes. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: OCI Direct Path loads a private CTAS stage on its own connection; business apply and receipt use the original transaction. Stage cleanup is deferred until the branch resolves. Complete driver type acceptance, real TCPS integration and performance remain pending.

items.name: Enterprise file layouts and publication
items.trigger: Encoding/layout settings or append/overwrite requires restart-safe publication.
items.baselineFinding: Publication facts and file checksums exist but enterprise format/append generation rules are incomplete.
items.acceptance: Encoding/layout settings or append/overwrite requires restart-safe publication. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: CSV discovery/read/write share one Native fileFormat for UTF-8/UTF-16LE/UTF-16BE/ISO-8859-1, Unicode delimiter/qualifier, fixed Unicode widths, header/preamble/skip lines, positions, null marker and row delimiter. File Sinks now use Native Journal-backed generation publication: preserve/check original bytes, persist prepared output digest before atomic publish, and prove a recovered published generation. CSV/NDJSON/Arrow/Parquet append streams original records through the same codecs. XLSX append preservation remains unsupported; process-kill/codec acceptance is registered but not run.

items.name: Incremental overlap target capability proof
items.trigger: An overlapping incremental source binds to an idempotent/receipted destination.
items.baselineFinding: Incremental binding currently depends on SQL upsert configuration rather than an explicit target guarantee.
items.acceptance: An overlapping incremental source binds to an idempotent/receipted destination. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Incremental overlap binds the KEYED_REPLACE effect and declared-key lineage rather than sql.destination/upsert names. Actual destination guarantees still require native/provider behavior acceptance.

items.name: Unified file and database discovery
items.trigger: A designer/SDK discovers a file or database schema.
items.baselineFinding: Database metadata maps to Data Schema; file inference is not unified.
items.acceptance: A designer/SDK discovers a file or database schema. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Database and file resources return Data Schema through the same discovery API. Bounded CSV/NDJSON/JSON-array sampling preserves integer/Decimal domains and identities; unsupported JSON unions/nesting remain explicit. Full formats and behavior acceptance remain pending.

items.name: One SDK and protocol family
items.trigger: A package/plugin/wire/checkpoint built for the old epoch is consumed.
items.baselineFinding: The baseline product authority reports SDK 1.5.0 / ABI 9; old document versions are strictly checked.
items.acceptance: A package/plugin/wire/checkpoint built for the old epoch is consumed. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Unified current contract implementation exists; concentrated ABI 10 compile/behavior validation has not run.

items.name: SQLite indexed Native Catalog
items.trigger: Catalog versions, executions or events are queried with concurrent workers.
items.baselineFinding: ud_catalog_list enumerates every .udc file, parses and validates all envelopes.
items.acceptance: Catalog versions, executions or events are queried with concurrent workers. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native SQLite WAL/transactions/indexes replace .udc scans; immutable versions, keyed digests, tenant isolation and bounded pagination share the current Catalog API. Behavior validation NotRun.

items.name: Durable execution logs
items.trigger: An execution produces task/component/error events or logs are paginated.
items.baselineFinding: Native observer events are versioned/sequenced but persistent indexed query/retention is absent.
items.acceptance: An execution produces task/component/error events or logs are paginated. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native event records now retain bounded identifier/status error frames and execution sequences. SQLite query filters include task/pipeline/component/result/event kind and time bounds. Bounded authorized event retention preserves the last sequence per execution and all Journal/deployment/job facts. Log persistence/query/retention acceptance remains NotRun.

items.name: Deployment and execution management
items.trigger: A deployment is enabled/disabled or a worker is dispatched/cancelled/recovered.
items.baselineFinding: Immutable deployment binding exists; process manager and enable/disable state are absent.
items.acceptance: A deployment is enabled/disabled or a worker is dispatched/cancelled/recovered. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Management API dispatches immutable package/deployment versions via Native Catalog.BindPackage. Durable queue records, worker start handshake, single-manager ownership, cancel/recovery and process identity checks are implemented. Restart, cancellation and unknown-outcome acceptance remain pending.

items.name: CLI resource policy
items.trigger: CLI resolves authorized resources and credential references.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: CLI resolves authorized resources and credential references. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: The file-root-only Native CLI implementation is retired. The .NET 10 CLI shares HostPolicy, credential references and SDK loading with the product Worker. CLI recovery locates the original state directory through Native Catalog and keeps its execution ID. Product build/install acceptance is pending.

items.name: Online Schema Change barrier
items.trigger: A compatible/incompatible runtime schema event reaches an epoch boundary.
items.baselineFinding: Pipeline routes SCHEMA_CHANGE but returns incompatible instead of rebinding at a barrier.
items.acceptance: A compatible/incompatible runtime schema event reaches an epoch boundary. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: CDC accepts only schema mappings that preserve the bound component contract. Driver decoders rebind, downstream pure configure runs again, source version and actual decoder schema persist in the epoch/snapshot. Schema observations include the source position before admission, and incompatibility stops confirmation. Wider output-contract evolution, provider-origin identity proof and real recovery acceptance remain pending.

items.name: CDC field presence and key images
items.trigger: Default replica identity, partial UPDATE/DELETE or a binlog field type is decoded.
items.baselineFinding: CDC batches carry before/after values but no explicit field-presence or key-image contract.
items.acceptance: Default replica identity, partial UPDATE/DELETE or a binlog field type is decoded. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native binary JSON decoding retains full integer/opaque Decimal/temporal values. MySQL ENUM ordinals and SET bitmaps preserve ordered dictionaries, empty/numeric labels and sentinel zero across Schema/Wire/Arrow. MINIMAL/NOBLOB binlog images retain presence; SQL projections and controlled LOAD DATA use explicit unsigned conversion. Real integration and online schema evolution remain pending.

items.name: Plain REST and receipt guarantees
items.trigger: A normal HTTP response is lost after the server may have committed.
items.baselineFinding: REST destination requires receiptUrl, so plain response acknowledgement is unavailable.
items.acceptance: A normal HTTP response is lost after the server may have committed. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native REST declares response, idempotent and receipt delivery modes. Response mode sends once and unresolved durable intents stop automatic replay; transport cancellation/timeout after send can be CommitUnknown. Live TLS/recovery acceptance remains pending.

items.name: Row SQL command parameter binding
items.trigger: Each input row invokes a parameterized external SQL command.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: Each input row invokes a parameterized external SQL command. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: sql.command processes input rows through native typed parameter binding, has a shared error output under real savepoints and declares external writes. Durable intents stop unproved response replay; accepted facts share the Native transaction journal. Real parameter/constraint/recovery acceptance remains pending.

items.name: Public managed Registry and native callback ownership
items.trigger: A managed component/task is registered and an exception escapes its callback.
items.baselineFinding: .NET ExecutionOptions carries registry/observer pointers internally but public APIs do not expose them.
items.acceptance: A managed component/task is registered and an exception escapes its callback. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Managed C# components/tasks and Java tasks register into the same leased Native Registry; callbacks have explicit Native/managed ownership and failures report to Native. A failed C# module registration fences the registry and retains assembly owners until Native teardown. Java Observer, error frames and debug project Native contracts. Installed SDK lifecycle acceptance remains NotRun.

items.name: Deployment-compiled C# scripts
items.trigger: CLI, Worker and SDK load a fixed deployment assembly through the same Registry.
items.baselineFinding: No common managed deployment assembly loader exists for Native hosts.
items.acceptance: CLI, Worker and SDK load a fixed deployment assembly through the same Registry. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: C# deployment compiles fixed deterministic assemblies with SDK/protocol attributes and digest-bound package extensions. Registry.LoadPackageExtensions is the SDK/CLI/Worker entry, with host execute grant, frozen verified bytes and Registry-owned module lifetime. Deployment and cross-host behavior acceptance are pending.

items.name: Balanced batch dispatch
items.trigger: A batch is distributed to exactly one output while Multicast retains replication.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A batch is distributed to exactly one output while Multicast retains replication. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: balanced dispatches each batch to one output and checkpoints the Native dispatch position; multicast continues to copy to all outputs. Saturated-output performance, fairness and restore acceptance remain pending.

items.name: Import and Export Column
items.trigger: A row reads/writes an authorized external column resource.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A row reads/writes an authorized external column resource. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Import/Export Column are native transforms with common input/output/error batches, field identities, bounded Binary/UTF8 values and retained row provenance. Per-row relative file resolution is part of the existing Connection Manager binding and authorization owner; export uses Journal-backed generations keyed by source row ID and import freezes source digests. Codec/error/recovery and language consumption acceptance remains NotRun.

items.name: XML Source
items.trigger: XML records are parsed into the canonical Data Schema.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: XML records are parsed into the canonical Data Schema. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native Expat streaming record framing feeds bounded XPath extraction into canonical Data Schema and the shared error ports. Original raw records are retained only when configured; inherited namespaces are preserved. Native parser allocations are quota-owned. UTF-8 input, general Schema discovery and DOM reservation accuracy still require acceptance.

items.name: XPath XSLT and XSD tasks
items.trigger: An XML task applies a query, stylesheet or schema validation.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: An XML task applies a query, stylesheet or schema validation. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native Registry tasks implement XPath, XSLT and XSD through libxml2/libxslt, bounded input/output, Native file leases and the shared Journal-backed generation publisher. DTD, implicit schema/stylesheet modules and external loads are rejected. Actual behavior/resource/cancellation acceptance remains NotRun.

items.name: SMTP task
items.trigger: An authorized mail connection sends a message with cancellation handling.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: An authorized mail connection sends a message with cancellation handling. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: smtp.send uses the sole Native curl owner, scoped credentials, RFC 2047 UTF-8 subject words, MIME base64 body and Native cancellation/deadlines. An interrupted send is not automatically replayed. Real SMTP integration remains pending.

items.name: Windows WMI tasks
items.trigger: A Windows host invokes a WMI query/event task.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A Windows host invokes a WMI query/event task. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native WMI query and bounded event tasks use Windows COM, the common resource grant and cancellation/deadline checks. Scalar results retain signed/unsigned integer lexemes in a UTF8 JSON variable; unsupported arrays reject explicitly. Local namespaces use the Windows process identity; non-Windows binding rejects. Real Windows acceptance remains NotRun.

items.name: FTP and SFTP resources
items.trigger: An authorized remote file transfer participates in cancellation/publication.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: An authorized remote file transfer participates in cancellation/publication. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native FTP/SFTP upload/download tasks share Connection Manager grants, credential file references, curl progress/cancellation and local generation publication. SFTP requires a granted known-hosts file. Uploads explicitly declare replacement and do not claim transaction participation or safe replay. Real independent FTP/SFTP acceptance remains pending.

items.name: Avro IO
items.trigger: An Avro schema and records are imported/exported without lossy type coercion.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: An Avro schema and records are imported/exported without lossy type coercion. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native Avro OCF null/deflate framing, scalar and nested Data encoding, standard logical types plus explicit lossless UINT64/Duration/Interval extensions, file discovery, row-error ports and the common Journal-backed append/overwrite publisher are implemented. Unsupported named references and ambiguous unions are rejected; foreign interoperability and recovery acceptance remain NotRun.

items.name: DQS removed by Microsoft
items.trigger: The historical DQS capability is compared with current SSIS support.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: The historical DQS capability is compared with current SSIS support. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: SSAS Data Mining no longer supported
items.trigger: The historical Data Mining capability is compared with current SSIS support.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: The historical Data Mining capability is compared with current SSIS support. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: SQL Server maintenance Agent and SSAS XMLA
items.trigger: A specialized database/Agent/XMLA task is deployed.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A specialized database/Agent/XMLA task is deployed. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native SQL Server backup/check/index maintenance and Agent start/stop use the common SQL lease and parameter binding, with explicit server-file grants for backup. SSAS XMLA uses bounded XML preflight and the sole Native HTTP transport; interrupted or unparseable responses preserve CommitUnknown. These effects do not declare safe replay or transaction participation. SQL Server/SSAS integration remains NotRun.

items.name: Exact Distinct profiling with shared Compute budget
items.trigger: Profiling requires exact distinct counts under memory and spill limits.
items.baselineFinding: profile.c uses approximate HLL while exact value_set is already owned by Compute.
items.acceptance: Profiling requires exact distinct counts under memory and spill limits. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Profile exact Distinct uses the existing native Compute value set under context/row budgets; approximate HLL is retained only for explicitly named approxDistinct aggregation. Concentrated acceptance has not run.

items.name: Durable job queue and schedules
items.trigger: A timer enqueues work, service restarts or a worker fails with unknown commit.
items.baselineFinding: No durable scheduler/queue exists in the Catalog.
items.acceptance: A timer enqueues work, service restarts or a worker fails with unknown commit. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Interval jobs, persisted queue/due times, job and host concurrency bounds, delayed bounded retries and restart restoration use Native SQLite Catalog. Retries retain the original execution ID and require Native Journal recovery; unknown outcomes stop automatic retries. Real scheduling/crash acceptance is pending.

items.name: Proven filter pushdown and streaming JSON array
items.trigger: A provider filter needs semantic proof or a large JSON array must stream.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A provider filter needs semantic proof or a large JSON array must stream. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: JSON Source uses one bounded Reader and shared errors for NDJSON and multiline array objects. Framing offsets are checked on resume; malformed boundaries remain fatal. Compilation and real source acceptance remain pending.

items.name: Azure Blob and ADLS Gen2
items.trigger: An authorized Azure object resource is read/published/recovered.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: An authorized Azure object resource is read/published/recovered. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Azure Blob native streaming PUT and ADLS Gen2 create/append/flush sequences use host credential references and the common curl owner. Native generation download, explicit remote replacement and unknown-commit fencing are implemented; actual Azure acceptance remains pending.

items.name: S3 and MinIO
items.trigger: An authorized S3 object resource is read/published/recovered.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: An authorized S3 object resource is read/published/recovered. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: S3/MinIO streaming GET/PUT uses curl SigV4 credentials from the host resolver and the common Native transfer/authorization lifecycle. Exclusive-create conditions and explicit replacement are declared. Real S3/MinIO signing and service acceptance remain pending.

items.name: ASP.NET Core 10 management and isolated workers
items.trigger: A management request creates/queries/controls an independent native execution process.
items.baselineFinding: No ASP.NET management product or execution process ownership exists.
items.acceptance: A management request creates/queries/controls an independent native execution process. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: ASP.NET Core 10 loopback service and multiple independent Worker processes project the same Native Execution/Registry/Catalog. Shared host resource scopes and credentials are explicit. APIs cover component metadata, schema, package versions, deployments, execution, logs, jobs, scripts and debug. Build/runtime/product acceptance is pending.

items.name: React Flow package designer
items.trigger: A user edits control/data flow, ports, mappings, connections, metadata or package layout.
items.baselineFinding: No React/TypeScript/React Flow package designer exists.
items.acceptance: A user edits control/data flow, ports, mappings, connections, metadata or package layout. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: React/TypeScript/React Flow designer sources implement control/data flow editing, dynamic handles, metadata forms, Native validation, connection editing, bounded undo/redo and versioned layouts. Deployment is bound to the saved immutable version; transport preserves integers beyond JS safe range. Field mapping, browser fidelity and complete workflow acceptance remain pending.

items.name: Safe native runtime debugging
items.trigger: A breakpoint, bounded edge preview or step request reaches an execution safety boundary.
items.baselineFinding: Execution exposes cancel/wait but no native debug controller.
items.acceptance: A breakpoint, bounded edge preview or step request reaches an execution safety boundary. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native Task/Batch/resolved-Epoch debug boundaries, explicit one-worker debug scheduling, bounded per-output previews and pause/continue/step APIs are connected to the SDK, Worker control pipe, management API and UI. Active transactions never park. Concurrency/cancellation/transaction/debug acceptance is pending.

items.name: Full Linux and Windows driver CI
items.trigger: CI must compile every declared driver and register SQL/CDC real integrations.
items.baselineFinding: Current CI is Linux-centric; Windows exemptions and advanced integration registration need removal.
items.acceptance: CI must compile every declared driver and register SQL/CDC real integrations. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Built-in drivers now use the existing Foundation mutex owner for Linux/Windows rather than direct pthread-only declarations. Full dependency matrix, real CI and Windows driver acceptance remain pending.

items.name: Independent release consumers and capability manifests
items.trigger: An independent directory consumes C, .NET, Java, CLI and Web release products.
items.baselineFinding: 1.5 artifacts are historical and must remain preserved; no ABI 10 consumer validation exists.
items.acceptance: An independent directory consumes C, .NET, Java, CLI and Web release products. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: HTTP response variable mappings
items.trigger: HTTP status/body/header output is bound to a declared native variable.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: HTTP status/body/header output is bound to a declared native variable. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: HTTP Task declares response body/header variables, permits typed UTF8/BINARY body retention and retains complete rejected-status responses. Ambiguous writes remain CommitUnknown. Real transport and variable-mapping acceptance remain pending.
